essence: Her presence is localized and iconically identified at the central point of the triangular diagram.
Worship directed to the triangle diagram both honors her and yields spiritual accomplishment.
Her presence, richness, and boon-giving power are all expressed through three syllables.
She possesses, governs, and dispenses the results of the three aims of life.
Regular twilight worship pleases her and twilight recitation leads to liberation.
